dex.text: Sits on clocks and nibbles the minutes off them. If you've ever lost an afternoon, check your pockets for a small gold grasshopper.
dex.fact: The Corpus Clock in Cambridge, unveiled in 2008, is ridden by a metal grasshopper that seems to eat each minute as it passes.

dex.text: Blinks one great eye at you as if to say: that minute was delicious. It runs fast, then slow, then stops dead, because time never feels like it runs evenly.
dex.fact: Chronophage is Greek for time-eater. The Corpus Clock salutes John Harrison, who invented the clock part called a grasshopper escapement in the 1720s.
